_comment: Sample pip artifact manifest. sha256 comes from PyPI's JSON API (https://pypi.org/pypi/fastapi/0.115.0/json — see .urls[0].digests.sha256). Install is via `pip install --require-hashes` against a generated requirements.txt referencing the locally cached wheel.
name: fastapi

metadata.note: Most planned runners use FastAPI. Shared dependencies like this one are installed once into a Python runtime that the runners mount, rather than per-runner. That keeps the hash set small and the audit surface small.
